mcqs.stem: A higher level of organization exhibits emergent properties when:

options: Cell → Organ → Tissue → Organelle → Organ system
Organelle → Cell → Tissue → Organ → Organ system
Tissue → Cell → Organelle → Organ → Organ system
Organ system → Tissue → Cell → Organelle → Organ
